name: Deli Heavy Duty Stapler, 210 Sheets Capacity
description:
Can easily staple up to 210 sheets of paper

Large handle for extra leverage and comfortable use

Strong, all-metal construction for long-lasting performance

Designed to withstand the demands of a fast-paced workplace

Compatible with heavy duty staples, size 23/6–23/24 (must use for proper function)

Color: As shown in picture

Description:
Make office work easier with this heavy duty desktop stapler. Built with durable all-metal construction and a large handle for extra leverage, it effortlessly staples up to 210 sheets of paper. Perfect for busy offices, schools, or home use, it ensures reliable performance day after day. Compatible only with heavy duty staples (23/6–23/24) for optimal function.
